summary: Cases and contacts CSV imports now reject rows whose tag matches an archived tag in the org (row error; commit refused with 400) instead of silently attaching a hidden archived tag; leads importer refactored onto shared Tags.archived_errors with a new message pointing to Settings > Tags; version bump 1.14.5->1.14.6 and docs.

statements.why: No new endpoints or permission changes; logic is org-scoped (Tags.archived_errors filters org=org, common/models.py:311-327) and tested for cross-org isolation.
Only the project's own version bump in the lockfile.

statements.text: • The agent changed docs/integrations/csv-import.md, a notes file (not code).
• The agent also changed backend/cases/services/csv_import.py, ..., backend/leads/tests/test_lead_import.py.
statements.why: True file list, but says nothing about what changed for users.

misses.what: Case and contact CSV imports that name an archived tag now fail: the row is flagged in preview and the whole import is refused at commit (400) until an admin restores the tag in Settings > Tags or the tag is removed from the file. Previously such rows imported and got a hidden archived tag.
Lead import error message for archived tags changes to "Tag 'VIP' is archived; an admin can restore it in Settings > Tags" (shows tag name as stored).
